concepts.learning_objective: Explain why the poet wonders whether childhood ended when he ceased to be eleven.
Analyse how logical reasoning about Heaven and Hell marks the end of childhood.
Interpret the poet's discovery that adults do not practise the love they preach.

topics.title: Stanza 3: A mind of one's own

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how forming independent thoughts signals the loss of childhood.
Interpret the image of childhood hidden in an infant's face.
Identify the poem's theme of growing up and the loss of innocence.
Identify the refrain and rhetorical questions and explain their effect.
Identify rhyme and repetition in the poem and evaluate their purpose.
